summary_en: Momo-no-Ki Co., Ltd. completed a tender offer for CAPITA Inc. shares from August 14 to September 10, 2026, acquiring 1,665,000 shares at or above the minimum threshold. Settlement commenced on September 17, 2026. KMO Capital LLP, the second-largest shareholder holding 1,665,000 shares (20.25% post-split), tendered all its shares and will cease to be a major shareholder.
title_en: Notice Regarding Results of Tender Offer for CAPITA Inc. Shares by Momo-no-Ki Co., Ltd., and Changes in Major Shareholders and Related Companies
translation_en_brief:
On September 10, 2026, the tender offer by Momo-no-Ki Co., Ltd. for CAPITA Inc. shares concluded successfully. The offer period ran from August 14 to September 10, 2026, and resulted in the acquisition of 1,665,000 shares, meeting the minimum threshold for the offer to become effective. Settlement of the transaction commenced on September 17, 2026.

KMO Capital LLP, CAPITA's second-largest shareholder, tendered all of its 1,665,000 shareholding (representing 20.3% of outstanding shares on a post-split basis after CAPITA executed a 1-for-2 stock split effective July 1, 2026) in the offer. Following settlement, KMO Capital LLP will cease to qualify as a major shareholder or related company of CAPITA as of September 17, 2026. The disclosure notes that one of KMO Capital LLP's partners, Sota Kitado, serves as a director of CAPITA.
